texts: When wraith activity at the Sunken Cove increases, the neighboring stations request feather rations from the Council.
Whenever wraith sightings at the Sunken Cove rise, the stations ask the Council for feather rations.
The Council weighs the requests against the central feather store.
The Council prioritizes stations with drained lanterns.

fields.sentence: When wraith activity at the Sunken Cove increases, the neighboring stations request feather rations from the Council.
parse: (: request_rule (Implication (And (Member $i increase) (Theme $i sk_activity_1) (PartOf $x sk_group_1)) (And (Member (sk_request $i $x) request) (Agent (sk_request $i $x) $x) (Theme (sk_request $i $x) feather_ration) (Source (sk_request $i $x) sk_council_1) (During (sk_request $i $x) $i))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: "the neighboring stations request …" is a definite plural with a distributive predicate, which the instruction set emits BOTH ways — a group-level event on `sk_group_1` plus the per-member rule — but only the per-member distribution appears, so "did the stations request rations?" at group level cannot bind.

q2_gaps: how the group-event + per-member-rule dual emission for a definite plural is realized when the predication sits inside a whenever-rule CONSEQUENT: every worked example of that dual emission is top-level, and no guidance covers minting the two Skolem events (group-level and per-member) inside one conclusion

whether an event-denoting noun's witness ("wraith activity", located "at the Sunken Cove") takes the entity head `LocatedIn` or the event oblique `Location` — the instruction set makes the head the event-vs-entity distinction but treats event-nouns as being the eventuality itself for tense and Time
review.notes: Strong elsewhere: the regularity is correctly quantified over increase occurrences rather than left as a one-off, "neighboring" is distributed to the members by the prescribed `(Implication (PartOf $x g) (Member $x neighboring))` rule rather than predicated of the group symbol, `Theme` on the scalar-change subject and `Source` for "from the Council" are right, and both compound genera correctly leave their noun modifiers unexposed.

issues.reason: A definite plural with a distributive predicate gets the group-as-unit predication (the stated default: 'predicating over the group as a unit is the default here') with the per-member rule added alongside — 'dropping either is a different, weaker claim' — and no group-level request event exists in any form, so with no PartOf members asserted the sentence's main claim is underivable at group level.

gaps_confirmed: no worked example realizes the group-event-plus-per-member dual emission inside a rule consequent

whether an event/activity-mass noun's locative ('wraith activity at the Sunken Cove') takes the entity head LocatedIn or the event oblique Location is unruled — the head is the event-vs-entity distinction and an activity noun sits on the line
adjudication.defect_summary: Compliant form: keep the parsed per-member rule and add a group-level twin keyed to the increase alone — (Implication (And (Member $i increase) (Theme $i sk_activity_1)) (And (Member (sk_request_g $i) request) (Agent (sk_request_g $i) sk_group_1) (Theme (sk_request_g $i) feather_ration) (Source (sk_request_g $i) sk_council_1) (During (sk_request_g $i) $i))) — composable from stated machinery, so a licensed form exists.
adjudication.notes: The rest follows the instruction set: occurrence quantification over increases rather than a one-off, the neighboring modifier distributed by rule instead of predicated of the group symbol, Theme on the scalar-change subject, bare-kind Theme for rations, and Source for 'from'.

fields.sentence: Whenever wraith sightings at the Sunken Cove rise, the stations ask the Council for feather rations.
parse: (: whenever_sightings_rise_ask (Implication (And (GroupOf $g wraith_sighting) (LocatedIn $g sunken_cove) (Member $r rise) (Theme $r $g)) (And (Member (sk_ask $r) ask) (Agent (sk_ask $r) sk_stations_1) (Recipient (sk_ask $r) sk_council_1) (For (sk_ask $r) feather_ration) (During (sk_ask $r) $r))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: "at the Sunken Cove" is attached with LocatedIn to a group of *sightings*, but a deverbal event-denoting noun is an eventuality elsewhere in the instruction set, where the locative head is Location and LocatedIn is reserved for things.

q2_gaps: locating an event-denoting noun, or a group of them: the instruction set fixes LocatedIn for entities and Location for events and calls the split mechanical, but never rules which side a deverbal event noun such as "sighting" falls on

a distributive predicate over a definite plural group ("the stations ask the Council") sitting inside a whenever-rule consequent: the per-member distribution rule a grouped plural normally adds has no shown or licensed form nested inside a rule conclusion
review.notes: Good calls elsewhere: "the Council" left as a capitalized common noun with no Name, "Sunken Cove" named and typed with no modifier genus, Theme on the scalar-change subject, and the preposition-named (For ...) rather than Beneficiary for the requested rations.

issues.reason: The instruction set never rules which side of the Location/LocatedIn split a deverbal event-noun falls on (the reviewer's own gap concedes this), and the choice is defensible on the letter — a GroupOf witness is an individual per the Categorical discipline and 'at' is in LocatedIn's containment list — so this is acceptable improvisation in gap territory, with no atom false or ill-typed.

gaps_confirmed: no rule assigns a locative PP on a deverbal event-denoting noun (or a group of them) to entity-side LocatedIn vs event-side Location
the per-member distribution rule a definite plural agent ('the stations') would normally add has no shown or licensed form when the predication sits inside a whenever-rule consequent
adjudication.notes: The rest of the parse tracks the whenever machinery exactly: Skolem ask event per rise occurrence with the During link, no QuantifierPhrase companion, habitual left unmarked, Theme on the scalar-change subject, the For-oblique for the requested rations, and Sunken Cove named/typed while the Council stays a Name-less common noun — all as legislated.

fields.sentence: The Council weighs the requests against the central feather store.

review.notes: "The Council" is correctly a capitalized common noun (no Name atom) and a singular collective that does not distribute, so it fills the Agent slot of one plain event; the definite plural "the requests" takes a GroupOf witness and rides Theme (weigh evaluates, it does not change the object), and Against is the licensed preposition-named oblique for the prepositional verb's object. central_feather_store emits its head genus plus the positional modifier genus and correctly leaves the noun modifier feather unexposed, and the bare simple present correctly carries no status atom.

fields.sentence: The Council prioritizes stations with drained lanterns.
parse: (: council_prioritize_rule (Implication (And (Member $s station) (Member $l lantern) (Member $l drained) (LocatedIn $l $s)) (And (Member (sk_prioritize $s) prioritize) (Agent (sk_prioritize $s) sk_council_1) (Theme (sk_prioritize $s) $s))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: (LocatedIn $l $s) renders the attributive 'with drained lanterns' as spatial containment the sentence never states — Core patterns bars exactly this world-knowledge relation, and LocatedIn is containment-only ('in / at / inside / within'), never the word 'with'.
The rule carries strength 1.0, but the clause has no quantifier word, so the verbal-generic dial gives a bare generic 0.9 (1.0 is reserved for all / each / every and for definite counted plurals).

q2_gaps: an attributive 'with'-PP modifying a NOUN ('stations with drained lanterns') — the instruction set's 'with' rules are event-level only (CoAgent for a comitative participant, Instrument for a means), and the entity-attached surface-preposition licence is framed around position and origin, so a characterizing 'with' on an entity has no stated encoding

a bare-plural OBJECT generic under a specific individual subject ('The Council prioritizes stations…') — the instruction set decides the rule-vs-event route by the SUBJECT, and never says whether such a clause becomes a rule ranging over the object kind (as here, needed to carry the restriction) or a plain event with a bare-kind filler
review.notes: Correct elsewhere: 'the Council' as a capitalized common noun with a witness and no Name atom, no distribution rule for the singular collective subject, Theme for the ranked-not-changed object, 'drained' kept as a participle-adjective and not fused, and no status atom on the present habitual. The two flagged problems are both on the single rule statement.

issues.reason: 'LocatedIn is containment ONLY — in / at / inside / within' and folding any other word into it 'asserts a containment the sentence never stated'; the surface 'with' states having, not spatial containment, so (LocatedIn $l $s) both breaks the containment-only rule and over-asserts.

The rule-strength dial sets strength by the quantity — all/each/every (or a definite plural/count) 1.0, bare generic 0.9 — and 'stations with drained lanterns' carries no quantifier word, so strength 1.0 asserts a universal the text does not state.

gaps_confirmed: an attributive 'with'-PP modifying a noun ('stations with drained lanterns') has no stated encoding — the 'with' rules are event-level (CoAgent/Instrument) and the entity-attached surface-preposition licence is framed for position and origin

a bare-plural object generic under a specific individual subject: unruled whether it becomes a rule ranging over the object kind (needed to carry the restrictor) or a plain event with a bare-kind filler
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: the compliant premise keeps the surface word entity-attached — (With $s $l), the same open licence as From-origin; if that licence is read as strictly position/origin-only, no licensed carrier exists and the confirmed attributive-'with' gap stands. Issue 1: the rule takes the bare-generic strength, (STV 0.9 0.9), since no quantifier word licenses 1.0.
adjudication.notes: The rule route itself (ranging over the object kind with the Council as a constant, Theme for the ranked object, 'drained' unfused, habitual unmarked) is reasonable improvisation inside the second confirmed gap; only the containment head and the over-strength fail the calibration line.
